source_state: measured from the final uncommitted Stage 2 remediation candidate; source_manifest.sha256 identifies every solver, harness, scenario, direct-reference, build, provenance, and configuration input affecting the measured computation

protocol.timer_scope: separate Sequential/OpenMP direct force, Sequential/OpenMP Barnes-Hut tree build and traversal, complete force-call wall time, and one complete OpenMP Barnes-Hut Velocity Verlet step

limitations: Exploratory single-machine measurements, not frozen Stage 5 evidence.
Only two repetitions per configuration; scheduling, clocks, affinity, host load, and thermals were uncontrolled.
The captured compiler, flags, commands, and OpenMP linkage identify this build but do not guarantee reproducible machine-level performance.
The matrix stops at 4096 bodies and cannot support 50000- or 100000-body performance or graphical-FPS claims.
Sequential timings are repeated across thread rows within a repetition because each reference call was intentionally measured once before the four OpenMP measurements.
The benchmark asserts bitwise Sequential/OpenMP Barnes-Hut force equality but relies on the separate Stage 1 evidence for approximation error against direct force.
